name: IndexTTS-2.5
access: Hugging Face weights IndexTeam/IndexTTS-2.5 (about 0.8B GPT backbone) and ModelScope
index-tts/index-tts repository: web UI, Python API, vLLM serving recipe
ModelScope Studio and Hugging Face Space demos

voice.input_audio: Text; a speaker reference clip; and optionally an 8-number emotion vector in the order happy, angry, sad, afraid, disgusted, melancholic, surprised, calm; or a separate emotion reference clip with a strength from 0 to 1; or an emotion description in text [gh-index]
voice.voices: custom cloning from one reference clip; emotion is separate from timbre, so one voice can take another clip's emotion [gh-index]
languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish and Arabic [hf-index25]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights under the bilibili Model Use License Agreement: royalty-free, but a user whose products had more than 100 million monthly active users, or whose annual revenue exceeded RMB 1 billion, must ask bilibili for a separate licence; the model and its derivatives may not be used to improve other AI models except non-commercial ones; no price [index-license]. About 6 GB of GPU memory for inference, Python 3.10 to 3.11, an NVIDIA GPU [hf-index25]
